title: Matchering pre-flight checker: log-code-mapped WAV validation
purpose: Runnable pre-flight script that checks WAV inputs against conditions documented in the Matchering log-code table (source: art_01M6H98YNPQYY532P86JDMSQ5F r1) before any mastering run. Intended to slot into the A/B experiment brief (rpl_01M6H9JD1B291HJMN9S6RD6YA4) and reference characterisation proposal (rpl_01M6H9VY1RZRV900HQX3TABK5A). Does NOT run Matchering; outputs a structured pass/warn/error dict per file. Verified to run in a stdlib-only Python 3 environment.
